settings.title.description: Heading at the top of the Roku Settings screen.

settings.general.description: Name of the General category in the Roku settings category list; opens appearance and profile preferences.

settings.playback.description: Name of the Playback category in the Roku settings category list; opens quality, audio, episode and skip options.

settings.subtitles.description: Name of the Subtitles category in the Roku settings category list.

settings.server.description: Name of the category in the Roku settings list for managing servers and the accounts signed in to them.

settings.diagnostics.description: Name of the Diagnostics category in the Roku settings category list, where users send problem reports.

settings.diagnostics.send.description: Button on the Roku Diagnostics settings pane that sends a problem report to Silo right away.

settings.diagnostics.erase.description: Button on the Roku Diagnostics settings pane that deletes the reports this device already sent.

settings.diagnostics.sending.description: Short status shown on the Roku Diagnostics pane while a report is being uploaded.

settings.diagnostics.sent.description: Status on the Roku Diagnostics pane after a report uploads. {reference}: the report's reference code, such as SILO-1A2B3C4D.

settings.diagnostics.failed.description: Short status on the Roku Diagnostics pane when a report could not be uploaded.

settings.diagnostics.withCrash.description: Small note under the Send Diagnostics button on Roku, saying the report will also include details of the app's most recent crash.

settings.diagnostics.none.description: Value shown on the Roku Diagnostics pane when no reports have been sent yet.

settings.diagnostics.count.description: Value on the Roku Diagnostics pane showing how many reports were sent. {count}: the number of reports.

settings.diagnostics.reference.description: Message on Roku after a diagnostics report is sent, asking the user to give the code to support. {reference}: the report's reference code.

settings.diagnostics.footer.description: Privacy footnote at the bottom of the Roku Diagnostics pane about what reports contain and how long they are kept. Ends with a web address that should stay unchanged.

settings.profile.description: Button in Roku settings that returns to the profile picker (Who's Watching) to switch to another profile.

settings.signOut.description: Button in Roku settings that signs the current account out of this device.

settings.on.description: Value shown on a Roku settings toggle row when the option is enabled.

settings.off.description: Value shown on a Roku settings toggle row when the option is disabled.

settings.noLimit.description: Value on a Roku settings row (such as Maximum Bitrate) meaning no cap is applied.

settings.noPreference.description: Value on a Roku settings language row meaning the user has not chosen a preferred language.

settings.originalLanguage.description: Option on a Roku audio language settings row meaning use the language the title was originally made in.

settings.useProfile.description: Option on a Roku settings row that removes this device's override so the profile's saved setting applies instead.

settings.accounts.account.description: Label on the Roku accounts settings pane for one signed-in account in a server's list.

settings.accounts.addAccount.description: Row on the Roku accounts pane that signs in another account on an existing server. {server}: the server's name.

settings.accounts.rename.description: Button on the Roku accounts pane that lets the user change a server's display name.

settings.accounts.renameTitle.description: Title of the Roku dialog for renaming a server. {server}: the server's current name.

settings.accounts.remove.description: Button on the Roku accounts pane that removes a server and its accounts from this device.

settings.accounts.removeTitle.description: Title of the Roku confirmation dialog for removing a server, phrased as a question. {server}: the server's name.

settings.accounts.removeMessage.description: Body of the Roku dialog confirming removal of a server; warns the user will be signed out of all accounts on it. {server}: the server's name.

settings.accounts.removeConfirm.description: Confirm button in the Roku dialog for removing a server.

settings.accounts.addServer.description: Row on the Roku accounts pane that starts connecting to a new server.

settings.accounts.profileCount.description: Small label under a server or account on the Roku accounts pane. Counts the profiles. {count}: the number of profiles.

settings.accounts.expiredTitle.description: Title of the Roku dialog offering to sign in again after an account's login expired, phrased as a question. {account}: the account's name; {server}: the server's name.

settings.accounts.expiredMessage.description: Body of the Roku dialog shown when an account's sign-in has expired, explaining its profiles are kept until the user signs in again or signs out.

settings.accounts.expiredMessageLast.description: Body of the Roku expired sign-in dialog when this is the server's last account; adds that signing out removes the server. {server}: the server's name.

settings.accounts.signInAgain.description: Confirm button in the Roku expired sign-in dialog that starts signing in again.

settings.accounts.footer.description: Footnote at the bottom of the Roku accounts pane explaining what signing out of an account or a server's last account does.

settings.description.general.description: Description shown for the General category on the Roku settings screen.

settings.description.playback.description: Description shown for the Playback category on the Roku settings screen.

settings.description.subtitles.description: Description shown for the Subtitles category on the Roku settings screen.

settings.description.server.description: Description shown for the Accounts category on the Roku settings screen.

settings.description.diagnostics.description: Description shown for the Diagnostics category on the Roku settings screen.

settings.railDescription.general.description: Very short subtitle under the General category in the narrow Roku settings side list. Refers to the title art option.

settings.railDescription.playback.description: Very short subtitle under the Playback category in the narrow Roku settings side list.

settings.railDescription.subtitles.description: Very short subtitle under the Subtitles category in the narrow Roku settings side list.

settings.railDescription.server.description: Very short subtitle under the Accounts category in the narrow Roku settings side list.

settings.railDescription.diagnostics.description: Very short subtitle under the Diagnostics category in the narrow Roku settings side list.

settings.control.titleArt.description: Toggle row label in Roku General settings; controls whether title artwork (logo images) is shown instead of plain text titles.

settings.control.resolution.description: Row label in Roku Playback settings for the maximum video resolution.

settings.control.bitrate.description: Row label in Roku Playback settings for the highest streaming bitrate allowed.

settings.control.bufferingQuality.description: Row label in Roku Playback settings; controls whether Silo lowers video quality automatically when playback keeps buffering.

settings.control.audioLanguage.description: Row label in Roku Playback settings for the preferred audio language.

settings.control.autoplay.description: Toggle row label in Roku Playback settings; start the next episode automatically when one ends.

settings.control.intros.description: Row label in Roku Playback settings for how episode intros are skipped.

settings.control.credits.description: Row label in Roku Playback settings for how end credits are skipped.

settings.control.recaps.description: Toggle row label in Roku Playback settings; automatically skip the previously-on recap at the start of an episode.

settings.control.skipBack.description: Row label in Roku Playback settings for how far the skip back button jumps.

settings.control.skipForward.description: Row label in Roku Playback settings for how far the skip forward button jumps.

settings.control.language.description: Row label in Roku Subtitles settings for the preferred subtitle language.

settings.control.behavior.description: Row label in Roku Subtitles settings for when subtitles are turned on automatically.

settings.control.forced.description: Toggle row label in Roku Subtitles settings; show forced subtitles (translations of foreign-language lines only).

settings.control.themeMusic.description: Toggle row label in Roku settings; play a show's theme song while viewing its detail page.

settings.control.themeMusicLoop.description: Toggle row label in Roku settings; repeat the theme music instead of playing it once.

settings.control.blurImages.description: Toggle row label in Roku settings; blur thumbnails of episodes the user has not watched, to avoid spoilers.

settings.control.hideOverviews.description: Toggle row label in Roku settings; hide descriptions of episodes the user has not watched, to avoid spoilers.

settings.section.appearance.description: Section heading in Roku General settings grouping display options.

settings.section.quality.description: Section heading in Roku Playback settings grouping quality options.

settings.section.streaming.description: Section heading in Roku Playback settings grouping streaming options such as bitrate and audio.

settings.section.episodes.description: Section heading in Roku Playback settings grouping episode options such as autoplay and skipping.

settings.section.video.description: Section heading in Roku settings grouping video options.

settings.section.tracks.description: Section heading in Roku Subtitles settings grouping subtitle track selection options.

settings.section.themeMusic.description: Section heading in Roku settings grouping the theme music options.

settings.section.profileLaunch.description: Section heading in Roku General settings for when the profile picker appears at app launch.

settings.control.profileSelection.description: Row label and picker title in Roku General settings for choosing when the app asks who is watching.

settings.profileLaunch.automatic.description: Option in the Roku profile selection picker: reuse the last profile without asking.

settings.profileLaunch.automatic.detail.description: Explanation under the Automatic option in the Roku profile selection picker. A protected profile is one with a PIN.

settings.profileLaunch.askEveryLaunch.description: Option in the Roku profile selection picker: always show the profile picker. Short label.

settings.profileLaunch.askEveryLaunch.de.description: Explanation under the Every Time option in the Roku profile picker. Who's Watching is the name of the profile picker screen.

settings.profileLaunch.afterOneHour.description: Option in the Roku profile selection picker: show the profile picker after being away one hour. Short label.

settings.profileLaunch.afterOneHour.deta.description: Explanation under the After 1 Hour option in the Roku profile picker. Who's Watching is the name of the profile picker screen.

settings.profileLaunch.afterTwelveHours.description: Option in the Roku profile selection picker: show the profile picker after being away twelve hours. Short label.

settings.profileLaunch.afterTwelveHours..description: Explanation under the After 12 Hours option in the Roku profile picker. Who's Watching is the name of the profile picker screen.

settings.section.spoilers.description: Section heading in Roku settings grouping spoiler protection options.

settings.spoilers.blurImages.description: Help text under the Roku toggle that blurs unwatched episode thumbnails, explaining what it hides and that it applies across devices.

settings.spoilers.hideOverviews.description: Help text under the Roku toggle that hides unwatched episode descriptions, explaining it applies across devices.

settings.loading.description: Status text shown on the Roku Settings screen while settings are loading from the server.

settings.saving.description: Short status shown on the Roku Settings screen while a changed setting is being saved.

settings.saved.description: Short status shown on the Roku Settings screen after a changed setting was saved.

settings.unsupported.description: Message in Roku settings when the connected server has no settings that can be edited from Roku.

settings.loadFailed.description: Error on the Roku Settings screen when settings could not be loaded; OK refers to the remote's OK button.

settings.refreshFailed.description: Error on the Roku Settings screen when a change saved but the updated settings could not be reloaded; OK refers to the remote's OK button.

settings.saveFailed.description: Error on the Roku Settings screen when a change could not be saved; the old value stays shown and the user selects the row to retry.

settings.navigation.description: Remote control hint on the Roku Settings screen: the Right button opens the settings pane and Back returns to browsing.

settings.profileScope.description: Note on Roku settings panes saying changes are saved to the profile and apply on all devices.

settings.deviceScope.description: Note on Roku settings panes saying changes only affect this Roku. The quoted option name must match the Use profile setting string.

settings.constrained.description: Note in Roku settings shown when the server's policy caps the user's choice. {value}: the value the user chose, such as 1080p.

settings.captionSystem.description: Note in Roku Subtitles settings saying caption visibility and style are controlled by the Roku system menu path shown. Keep the menu names matching Roku's own.

settings.section.metadata.description: Section heading in Roku settings grouping the metadata language option.

settings.control.metadataLanguage.description: Row label in Roku settings for the language used for descriptions and taglines.

settings.metadataLanguageNote.description: Help text under the Roku metadata language row explaining descriptions and taglines are translated when available but titles are not.

settings.rate.kbps.description: A bitrate in kilobits per second, shown on Roku and Android connection and bitrate settings. {rate}: the number, such as 800.

settings.rate.mbps.description: A bitrate in megabits per second, shown on Roku and Android connection and bitrate settings. {rate}: the number, such as 12.

settings.learnedLimit.description: Note in playback settings that Auto quality is capped because of past buffering. {rate}: the speed limit, such as 12 Mbps; {date}: a short month and day, such as Oct 17.

settings.learnedLimitUndated.description: Roku note that Auto quality is capped because of past buffering, when the date is unknown. {rate}: the speed limit, such as 12 Mbps.

settings.monthDay.description: Short date format used in the Roku buffering limit note. {month}: the abbreviated month name; {day}: the day number. Reorder if the language puts the day first.

settings.month.1.description: Abbreviated month name January, used in short dates like Jan 5 in Roku settings.

settings.month.2.description: Abbreviated month name February, used in short dates in Roku settings.

settings.month.3.description: Abbreviated month name March, used in short dates in Roku settings.

settings.month.4.description: Abbreviated month name April, used in short dates in Roku settings.

settings.month.5.description: Abbreviated month name May, used in short dates in Roku settings.

settings.month.6.description: Abbreviated month name June, used in short dates in Roku settings.

settings.month.7.description: Abbreviated month name July, used in short dates in Roku settings.

settings.month.8.description: Abbreviated month name August, used in short dates in Roku settings.

settings.month.9.description: Abbreviated month name September, used in short dates in Roku settings.

settings.month.10.description: Abbreviated month name October, used in short dates in Roku settings.

settings.month.11.description: Abbreviated month name November, used in short dates in Roku settings.

settings.month.12.description: Abbreviated month name December, used in short dates in Roku settings.

settings.connection.notMeasured.description: Value of the Connection Speed row in playback settings (Roku and Android) before any speed test has run.

settings.connection.measured.description: Connection Speed result line in playback settings. {rate}: the speed, such as 12 Mbps; {age}: how long ago, such as 5 minutes ago; {network}: the network type, such as Wi-Fi.

settings.connection.measuredUndated.description: Connection Speed result line when the time is unknown. {rate}: the speed, such as 12 Mbps; {network}: the network type, such as Wi-Fi.

settings.connection.lowerBound.description: Connection Speed result where the real speed is at least the shown value. {rate}: the speed, such as 50 Mbps; {age}: how long ago, such as 5 minutes ago; {network}: the network type, such as Wi-Fi.

settings.connection.lowerBoundUndated.description: Connection Speed result where the real speed is at least the shown value, time unknown. {rate}: the speed, such as 50 Mbps; {network}: the network type, such as Wi-Fi.

settings.connection.duringPlayback.description: Connection Speed line for a speed reached while playing a video, which is a minimum. {rate}: the speed, such as 20 Mbps; {age}: how long ago, such as 2 hours ago.

settings.connection.duringPlaybackUndate.description: Connection Speed line for a speed reached while playing a video, a minimum, with no time. {rate}: the speed, such as 20 Mbps.

settings.connection.age.justNow.description: Relative time used inside Connection Speed lines meaning the test was done moments ago.

settings.connection.age.minutes.description: Relative time used inside Connection Speed lines. Counts minutes since the test. {count}: the number of minutes.

settings.connection.age.hours.description: Relative time used inside Connection Speed lines. Counts hours since the test. {count}: the number of hours.

settings.connection.age.days.description: Relative time used inside Connection Speed lines. Counts days since the test. {count}: the number of days.

settings.connection.transport.wifi.description: Network type name inserted into Connection Speed lines (measured on Wi-Fi).

settings.connection.transport.ethernet.description: Network type name inserted into Connection Speed lines (measured on Ethernet, a wired connection).

settings.connection.transport.cellular.description: Network type name inserted into Connection Speed lines (measured on a mobile data connection). Lowercase in English mid-sentence.

settings.connection.transport.otherNetwo.description: Fallback network name inserted into Connection Speed lines when the type is unknown; reads as measured on this connection.

settings.connection.budget.description: Help text in connection settings explaining Auto quality plays videos without transcoding up to a speed. {rate}: the speed, such as 12 Mbps.

settings.connection.retry.description: Message telling the user to wait before running another speed test. Counts seconds. {count}: the number of seconds left.

settings.section.connection.description: Section heading in Roku Playback settings for the connection speed test.

settings.section.diagnosticsReport.description: Section heading in Roku Diagnostics settings above the send report controls.

settings.section.diagnosticsSent.description: Section heading in Roku Diagnostics settings above the list of already-sent reports.

settings.control.connectionSpeed.description: Row label in Roku Playback settings that shows and runs the connection speed test.

settings.connection.testing.description: Status shown on the Connection Speed row (Roku and Android) while a speed test is running.

settings.connection.reset.description: Roku button that clears the learned speed limit so Auto quality can use full quality again.

settings.connection.testHint.description: Roku hint on the Connection Speed row telling the user to press OK to start a speed test, which takes up to 10 seconds.

settings.connection.resetHint.description: Roku hint on the Reset row explaining it clears the speed limit so Auto plays at full quality again.

settings.connection.stopPlayback.description: Error shown (Roku and Android) when the user starts a speed test while a video is playing.

settings.connection.measureFailed.description: Error shown (Roku and Android) when the connection speed test could not complete.

settings.connection.notSaved.description: Roku error shown when a speed test ran but the server did not store the result.

settings.connection.resetFailed.description: Roku error shown when clearing the learned speed limit failed.

settings.bufferingQuality.always.description: Option in the Android buffering quality setting: lower quality automatically without asking.

settings.bufferingQuality.ask.description: Option in the Android buffering quality setting: ask the user before lowering quality.

settings.bufferingQuality.description.description: Help text under the Android Lower quality when buffering setting, explaining what Auto does and that a quality the user picked always prompts first.

settings.bufferingQuality.never.description: Option in the Android buffering quality setting: never lower quality automatically.

settings.bufferingQuality.title.description: Title of the buffering quality setting in Android playback settings; controls lowering video quality when playback keeps buffering.

settings.connection.notSavedShort.description: Android error shown when a speed test measured a result but the server did not store it.

settings.connection.skippedCellular.description: Footnote in Android connection settings explaining speed tests are not run on mobile data, where the Cellular Quality settings apply instead.

settings.connection.skippedMetered.description: Footnote in Android and Android TV connection settings explaining speed tests are not run on metered networks (limited data plans).

settings.connection.speed.description: Row label in Android playback settings for the connection speed result.

settings.connection.test.description: Button in Android connection settings that starts a connection speed test.

settings.connection.title.description: Section title in Android playback settings for the connection speed test and its results.

settings.learnedLimit.reset.description: Android button that clears the speed limit learned from past buffering.

settings.learnedLimit.resetFailed.description: Android error shown when clearing the learned speed limit failed.

settings.learnedLimit.undated.description: Android note that Auto quality is capped because of past buffering, shown when the date is unknown. {rate}: the speed limit, such as 12 Mbps.

settings.introSkip.always.description: Option in the skip intros setting on Android phone and TV: skip intros without asking.

settings.introSkip.ask.description: Option in the skip intros setting on Android phone and TV: show a button the user can press to skip.

settings.introSkip.never.description: Option in the skip intros setting on Android phone and TV: never skip intros.

settings.introSkip.title.description: Label of the intro skipping option in the Android player settings sheet and the Android TV player menu.

diagnostics.consent.title.description: Title of the Roku dialog asking permission to send a diagnostics report, phrased as a question.

diagnostics.consent.message.description: Body of the Roku diagnostics consent dialog, listing what the report includes and leaves out and how long it is kept.

diagnostics.consent.confirm.description: Confirm button in the Roku diagnostics consent dialog that sends the report.

diagnostics.cancel.description: Cancel button in the Roku diagnostics dialogs.

diagnostics.erase.title.description: Title of the Roku dialog confirming deletion of previously sent diagnostics reports, phrased as a question.

diagnostics.erase.message.description: Body of the Roku dialog confirming deletion of sent reports; the reference codes users saved will stop working.

diagnostics.erase.confirm.description: Confirm button in the Roku dialog for deleting sent diagnostics reports.

diagnostics.crash.title.description: Title of the Roku dialog shown on launch after the app crashed.

diagnostics.crash.message.description: Body of the Roku crash dialog asking whether to send a report, listing what it includes and what it never includes.

diagnostics.crash.confirm.description: Button in the Roku crash dialog that sends the crash report.

diagnostics.crash.cancel.description: Button in the Roku crash dialog that declines sending the report.

diagnostics.notice.sent.description: Brief notice on Roku after a diagnostics report was sent. {reference}: the report's reference code.

diagnostics.notice.failed.description: Brief notice on Roku when a diagnostics report could not be sent.

person.filmography.description: Heading on the Roku person (actor or crew) page above the list of their movies and series.

person.filter.all.description: Filter tab on the Roku person page that shows both movies and series.

person.filter.movies.description: Filter tab on the Roku person page that shows only movies.

person.filter.series.description: Filter tab on the Roku person page that shows only TV series.

person.count.description: Count label on the Roku person page for the number of titles linked to the person. {count}: the number of titles.

person.countMore.description: Count label on the Roku person page when more titles exist than are loaded; the plus sign means at least this many. {count}: the number of titles loaded so far.

person.born.description: Line on the Roku person page with the birth date. {date}: the formatted date.

person.died.description: Line on the Roku person page with the date of death. {date}: the formatted date.

person.age.description: Line on the Roku person page with the person's age. {age}: the number of years.

person.empty.description: Heading on the Roku person page when the person has no movies or series.

person.emptyBody.description: Explanation on the Roku person page under the empty heading, when no titles are linked to the person.

person.notFound.description: Heading on the Roku person page when the person does not exist on the server.

person.error.load.description: Error on the Roku person page when the person's details could not be loaded.

person.error.titles.description: Error on the Roku person page when the person's list of titles could not be loaded.

personal.watchlist.title.description: Title of the Watchlist screen on Roku, a list of titles the user saved to watch later.

personal.watchlist.empty.description: Heading on the Roku Watchlist screen when the list is empty.

personal.watchlist.emptyBody.description: Explanation on the empty Roku Watchlist screen on how to add titles.

personal.watchlist.remove.description: Option on Roku that removes the selected title from the Watchlist.

personal.favorites.title.description: Title of the Favorites screen on Roku, a list of titles the user marked as favorites.

personal.favorites.empty.description: Heading on the Roku Favorites screen when the list is empty.

personal.favorites.emptyBody.description: Explanation on the empty Roku Favorites screen on how to add favorites.

personal.favorites.remove.description: Option on Roku that removes the selected title from Favorites.

personal.history.title.description: Title of the watch History screen on Roku, a list of titles the user has watched.

personal.history.empty.description: Heading on the Roku History screen when nothing has been watched.

personal.history.emptyBody.description: Explanation on the empty Roku History screen saying watched items will show up there.

personal.history.remove.description: Option on Roku that removes the selected title from watch History.

personal.count.description: Count label on the Roku Watchlist, Favorites and History screens. {count}: the number of items in the list.

personal.countMore.description: Count label on the Roku Watchlist, Favorites and History screens when more items exist than are loaded; the plus sign means at least this many. {count}: the number of items loaded so far.

personal.updateFailed.description: Error on Roku when adding or removing an item in Watchlist, Favorites or History failed.
